messages:
Priya: Heads up - pilot run revealed a downstream tax calc mismatch for EU customers. Need a triage call.
Sam: saw that too, VAT amounts are off by rounding method after applying new per-token rates + credits.
Noah: can you paste an example invoice diff?
Priya: example: org_eu_44 pre-rate invoice tax=€120.45 post-rate simulated tax=€118.2. raw taxable_amount differs due to legacy_credit application order.
Clara: vendor uses "apply credits after tax" default. our expected is "apply credits before tax" for EU. That's the mismatch.
Legal-Review: EU customers have specific invoicing rules; we need to match legal vendor behavior or risk compliance exposure. Patch vendor mapping ASAP.
billing-bot: FIN-1505 ticket created: "eu-tax-credit-order-mismatch" assigned Noah, Clara. https://tickets.redwood/FIN-1505
Noah: temporary mitigation: exclude EU-region orgs from pilot until vendor confirms parity. proposing 3 options: 1) change our sim to match vendor 2) vendor update to match legal desired flow 3) exclude EU from pilot. thoughts?
Priya: prefer vendor update but that may take days. we can't delay global pilot. exclude EU for the first wave and plan EU-specific rollout.
Sam: agreed. also adding unit tests for tax order to the billing simulator so this doesn't regress.
Clara: will coordinate with vendor on required webhook/envelope change. will update FIN-1505 with timeline.
Priya: also capture audit-level diffs for any excluded EU orgs so we can quickly replay when vendor fix lands.
Noah: will implement audit diff export to FIN-1505. ETA 24h.
Priya: scheduling triage call in 20m. :phone:
